svg.text: The four ways traffic reaches a pod
you must know a node IP
NodePort is a ClusterIP plus a node port. LoadBalancer is a NodePort plus a cloud load balancer.
An Ingress sits in front of ClusterIP Services. You are always building on the one to its left.
Type LoadBalancer creates one AWS load balancer per Service. Forty microservices means forty load
balancers, forty hostnames and forty bills. An Ingress gives you one, routing by path to all of them.
